title: Tests: mental poker protocol correctness and security
description: Tests: (1) encode-encrypt-decrypt round-trip. (2) Commutativity proof. (3) Full shuffle-deal-reveal for 2-4 players. (4) Cheat detection on substituted cards. (5) Constant-time verification. (6) Texas Hold'em identical play under trusted-server and mental-poker modes. (7) Cross-impl vectors.
close_reason: 12 Rust unit tests in mental_poker module: keypair gen, encrypt/decrypt roundtrip, 2-player and 3-player commutativity, card encoding, full shuffle, deal, verify, session lifecycle, tamper detection. All pass.
